ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
